continuum_problem.field: Psi in C^3, treated as six real components
continuum_problem.flow: partial_t Psi = -R[Psi], where R is the real-L2 gradient of the P1 reference functional
continuum_problem.regularity_input: P2 gives a unique global H2 solution and C-infinity smoothing for every t>0
continuum_problem.scope: pinned production parameters, positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers, eta_shell=0

spatial_discretization.space: S_N = three-component trigonometric polynomials on the fftfreq cube
spatial_discretization.projector: P_N is the real-L2 Fourier projector onto S_N
spatial_discretization.collocation_residual: R_N^C is the hash-pinned P1 backend gradient of the collocation energy
spatial_discretization.dealiasing_rule: Stage 1 uses the same backend at higher resolution followed by Fourier projection as a numerical proxy for R_N^G; an oversampling-reference stability error must be reported. Independent continuum-residual evaluation remains required for closure.
spatial_discretization.honesty_boundary: R_N^C is not called exact Galerkin. Its difference from R_N^G is an aliasing error that must converge to zero.

norms.residual_relative: ||R_N^C-P_N R_ref^C||_L2 / max(||P_N R_ref^C||_L2,1e-30) for the stage-1 same-backend oversampled reference
norms.ritz: real-L2 Rayleigh-Ritz values on a declared projected subspace

required_gates: spectral Galerkin residual versus continuum residual
Hessian/Ritz grid convergence under an isolated-cluster condition

stage1.manufactured_field: analytic, nonzero-density, three-component complex trigonometric field with all Class-II channels active

time_manufactured.forcing: S_N(t)=partial_t Psi_star_N(t)+R_N^C(Psi_star_N(t)); this isolates temporal order for the semidiscrete ODE

unforced_cross_grid.initial_data: the stage-1 analytic manufactured spatial field
unforced_cross_grid.comparison: project each reference trajectory to the target grid; report reference-grid uncertainty separately

homogeneous_block.basis: cosine and sine profiles times all six internal real coordinates
homogeneous_block.purpose: translation invariance makes this a candidate invariant Hessian block, allowing a residual/gap eigenvalue certificate

manufactured_ritz.basis: fixed orthonormal low-frequency real Fourier directions
manufactured_ritz.field: nonzero-density three-component Class-II-active stress field with Fourier indices up to 3, chosen to expose N=8 aliasing rather than start at the finite-difference floor
manufactured_ritz.purpose: grid convergence of a non-invariant Ritz matrix at a nonuniform Class-II-active stress field; no full-spectrum eigenvalue claim

stage4.availability_rule: CUDA rows are PASS or FAIL only when torch.cuda.is_available(); otherwise they are UNAVAILABLE and the hardware gate remains open

stage5.field: stage-1 analytic nonzero-density three-component manufactured field, prolonged from each target grid

solution_ball.initial_space: B_R={u0 in H2(T3;C3): ||u0||_H2 <= R}, for arbitrary R>0
solution_ball.p2_input: P2 global H2 well-posedness, energy control, and positive-time C-infinity smoothing imply a finite B6(R,tau,T) envelope on every fixed 0<tau<=t<=T interval.

stage6.theorem_statement: For every R>0 and 0<tau<=T<infinity, there is C(R,tau,T)<infinity such that every P2 solution from B_R satisfies sup_{tau<=t<=T} ||P_N R(u(t))-R_N^C(P_N u(t))||_L2 <= C(R,tau,T) N^-2.
stage6.constant_status: QUANTITATIVE for the declared radii R=0.5,1,2 at tau=0.02 and T=0.2: Stage 8 evaluates finite B6 and C enclosures. The constants are deliberately conservative and are not practical solver error bars.

stage7_energy_ball.statement: For every R in the declared H2-radius list, the canonical P1 energy is explicitly bounded above by E_upper(R); P2 dissipation and coercivity give ||u(t)||_H2 <= M2(R) for every t>=0.
stage7_energy_ball.method: A max-norm-shell upper bound for the Fourier H2-to-Linfinity embedding, the canonical Pauli-generator current bound, and the P2 Young/coercivity constants.

classii_contraction_breakdown.field_components: absorbed by operator-norm AJ/AK estimates after the isometric C3-to-R6 realification

stage8_quantitative_majorant.statement: For each declared H2 initial radius, compute explicit two-step endpoint-cancellation bounds B4 and B6 on [tau,T], an explicit collocation/Galerkin residual constant C multiplying N^-2, and a restarted exact-Galerkin evolution constant multiplying N^-4. The evolution estimate must use a separately derived Galerkin energy ball rather than importing the continuum M2 ball.
stage8_quantitative_majorant.evolution_scope: The exact Galerkin flow is restarted at t=tau with P_N u(tau). This avoids claiming an algebraic rate at t=0 for merely H2 initial data.

stage9_adversarial_repair.trigger: Post-promotion adversarial review found that v1.0 used the continuum M2 ball for the restarted exact-Galerkin trajectory, and that selected displayed upper bounds were rounded inward.
